headline: TODO-GEORGE: draft headline — cement's permitting relief under NZIA against its electricity input share
body:
[DRAFT — George to replace]

This finding is a placeholder that exists so the finding pages render against a real citation and a real exposure figure. The measure it cites is real: the Net-Zero Industry Act lets a decarbonisation project spanning several facilities on one site be split for permitting purposes, and it names cement among the industries that may use it.

The exposure figure is real too: electricity and gas supply 8.1% of the cement sector's total inputs in the EU view of the FIGARO table. What the finished finding has to say is what those two facts mean together — and that sentence has not been written yet.

evidence.notes: TODO-GEORGE: FIGARO groups cement and glass under one code (C23), so the input share is shared between the two. Say so in the finished text, or drop the exposure reference.
